senses.gloss: m. (רפף, v. הֲרִיפָה) trembling; ה׳ עַיִן wink, an indefinable portion of time.
units: Y. Ber. I, 2ᵇ bot. בין השמשות כה׳ ע׳ the time called ben-hash-sh’mashoth is really like a wink of the eye. Ib.ᶜ top. Ib.ᵈ top; Lam. R. to II, 19; v. רֶגַע.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:3">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>בה׳ ע׳</he> (not <he>כה׳</he>) instantaneously; a. fr.
